text:
owen: Kickoff for SummitBridge POC. Req: streaming chat with NDJSON lines, tool/function calls, strict JSON schema per event, SAML SSO, BYOK for at-rest encryption. Hosted POC but they want ephemeral browser creds and resumable reconnect. Also want a cost estimate for short bursts ~1k QPS for 10-20m.

kara: Quick clarifiers: browser uses direct SSE on product pages? server workers for enrichment?

owen: Yes both. Browser SSE on product pages, server-side websocket workers. Ephemeral creds in browser preferred.

yusuf: Tech notes: Node/Python SDKs ok. Browser: SSE is simplest for NDJSON; server: websocket. Function calls arrive as NDJSON events like `{"type":"function_call","name":"lookup_inventory","args":{...}}`. For strict schema embed JSON Schema in system prompt and validate assembled objects client-side.

yusuf: Token rotation caveat: mid-stream credential rotation + SSE can cause 401/reconnect loops. Workarounds: server-side token broker for browsers, or return a resumable_id on stream start so reconnects provide resumable_id+offset. We have a small helper in branch "stream-resume-lite" that emits resumable_id control event.

security-bot: Hosted+BYOK OK on enterprise plan; legal LOA + KMS attestation required. SOC2 report available under NDA. For guaranteed customer-managed-at-rest encryption you may need Dedicated. Expect 2-3 week lead time for BYOK/legal items.

kara: Action items: Yusuf can you draft a 1-page runbook (SSE NDJSON example, resumable_id pattern, function_call handling, token-broker example, and a simple cost calc for the burst scenario)? Owen will share contact and schedule demo.

yusuf: Yep. Will include a tiny curl example, a Node SSE snippet, and a hosted vs dedicated cost comparison spreadsheet.

owen: Customer contact is claire@summitbridge.com. Target demo Thurs. Thanks all.
